answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 90 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The marble register is checked at draw time, crystal lists the eligible set, and kernel seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 90 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
